in_hebrew.name: Fronia
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fronia הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'fronē', meaning 'to think, to advise, to show respect'. In Greek mythology, Fronia was a goddess of honesty and respect. In Christianity, this name symbolizes the honesty and respect we should show to God and others.
